title: QuoteIQ vs Jobber (2026): Pricing, Users & Features
description: QuoteIQ vs Jobber: plan prices, included users, extra-user cost, routing, QuickBooks, chemical tracking and trials, from each vendor's pricing page.
h1: QuoteIQ vs Jobber for small service businesses
body:
QuoteIQ and Jobber both cover quoting, scheduling, invoicing and payments for lawn, pressure washing, window cleaning, pool and pest businesses. They package users differently. QuoteIQ sells five plans that each include a set number of users (1 to 20), and you can add users to any plan at $25/mo each. Jobber prices most plans for 1 user, sells 5-, 10- and 15-user tiers, and charges $29/mo for each extra user. Every number below comes from each vendor's own pricing page: QuoteIQ pricing (checked 2026-11-02) and Jobber pricing (checked 2026-11-08). If a vendor doesn't publish something, we mark it unknown.

{{table:quoteiq,jobber}}

Plans and prices

  • QuoteIQ: Essentials $29.99/mo (1 user), Beginner $99.99/mo (2 users), Pro $199.99/mo (4 users), Elite $299.99/mo (10 users) and Max $699.99/mo (20 users). Extra users are $25/mo each on every plan, up to 100. Annual billing is 10 months' price for 12 months (for example $299.99/yr for Essentials). There's a 14-day free trial on every plan, but a credit or debit card is required to start. No contracts or cancellation fees.
  • Jobber: Core is $29/mo billed annually, $39/mo on a 1-year commitment billed monthly, or $49/mo with no commitment, for 1 user. Connect is $99/$119/$139 and Grow $149/$169/$199 for 1 user (annual / 1-year monthly / no commitment). Plus is $399/$439/$499 with 5 users included. Connect and Grow also come in 5-user ($149 and $229/mo billed annually), 10-user and 15-user tiers. Extra users are $29/mo each. The 14-day free trial runs on Grow and needs no credit card. Annual prepaid billing is non-refundable.

What the same team costs on each

We worked these out from the list prices above (USD per month, before tax and payment fees). QuoteIQ is shown at monthly prices. For Jobber we show billed-annually prices, plus the no-commitment price where Jobber publishes one. "Cheapest published way" means the lowest plan that reaches the head count, adding extra users where needed. It ignores which features you need, so check the feature table above too.

TeamQuoteIQ (monthly)Jobber (billed annually / no commitment)

Solo who needs route optimizationElite $299.99 (10 users)Connect $99 / $139
Solo who needs QuickBooksPro $199.99 (4 users)Connect $99 / $139

5 users with route optimizationElite $299.99 (10 users included)Connect 5-user $149; Grow 5-user $229 (annual)

The pattern: QuoteIQ costs least at the bottom, with $29.99/mo for one user with no annual commitment against Jobber's $49/mo. Adding users is also cheaper ($25 vs $29 each). But QuoteIQ puts route optimization on Elite and QuickBooks on Pro, so a small team that needs either one often pays less on Jobber Connect. Jobber's lowest prices need annual prepayment, which is non-refundable.

Which should you pick?

  • Solo, quoting from the truck, no route optimization needed: QuoteIQ Essentials ($29.99/mo, no annual commitment), or Beginner ($99.99/mo) if you want MapMeasure Pro and QuoteIQ Cam. {{aff:quoteiq|Try QuoteIQ}}
  • Small team that needs routing or QuickBooks Online: Jobber Connect ($99/mo for 1 user or $149/mo for 5 users, billed annually). {{aff:jobber|See Jobber plans}}
  • Chemical records (lawn, pest, pool): QuoteIQ lists chemical tracking from Pro. Jobber's pricing page doesn't list it.
  • You don't want to enter a card for the trial: Jobber's Grow trial needs no credit card. QuoteIQ's trial requires one.

faq: For one user with no annual commitment, yes: QuoteIQ Essentials is $29.99/mo and Jobber Core is $49/mo (Jobber Core is $29/mo billed annually). Extra users cost $25/mo on QuoteIQ and $29/mo on Jobber. QuoteIQ puts route optimization on Elite ($299.99/mo), so if you need routing, Jobber Connect ($99/mo billed annually) costs less. Prices checked 2026-11-02 (QuoteIQ) and 2026-11-08 (Jobber).
Do QuoteIQ and Jobber have free trials?
Yes, both are 14 days. QuoteIQ's trial is on every plan and requires a credit or debit card. Jobber's trial runs on the Grow plan and needs no credit card.
QuoteIQ includes route optimization on Elite and Max. Jobber includes routing (route optimization) and GPS tracking on Connect and up, not on Core.
Do QuoteIQ and Jobber sync with QuickBooks?
QuoteIQ lists a QuickBooks integration on Pro ($199.99/mo) and up. Jobber syncs with QuickBooks Online and Xero on Connect ($99/mo billed annually) and up.
